capabilities: Toggle a selected file path between path and file:// URI
Paste a clipboard path as a file:// URI
Paste a clipboard path as a Markdown link to a file:// URI
Paste a clipboard path as a URI link titled with only the file or folder name
Strip surrounding whitespace and quotation marks from converted paths
extras: The README prominently warns that the plugin is largely unnecessary because dragging a file or folder into a note while holding Ctrl makes Obsidian paste it as a file link natively.
problem: Obsidian links normally point to vault files, and linking to a local file or folder outside the vault requires manually encoding the path as a file:// URI.
summary: Converts local file paths into file:// URI links for files outside the vault, via commands that transform selections or clipboard contents.
